description: A controlled spinal articulation movement developing hamstring length and sequential spinal flexion strength under gentle load.
setup: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart on a flat floor, knees straight with soft micro-bend, and arms hanging freely.
steps: Tuck chin down toward chest and slowly round through cervical spine.
Continue rolling downward vertebra by vertebra through mid back and lower spine, letting arms dangle.
Descend until maximum comfortable hamstring and spinal stretch is achieved at bottom.
Reverse smoothly by stacking lower back, upper back, shoulders, and head back to tall standing.
cues: Move one individual vertebra at a time
Keep leg muscles gently active and knees soft

mistakes.mistake: Rushing the movement and hinging from hips with a flat back
mistakes.fix: Focus entirely on rounding and unrolling the spine like a curling rope

mistakes.mistake: Bending knees excessively during the bottom stretch
mistakes.fix: Keep legs relatively straight to allow hamstrings and calves to lengthen safely

rep_standard: Controlled segmented descent down to active range, unrolling smoothly to vertical posture
